chronology: Used-source design after earlier/incidental abstract outcomes and masked methods/label inspection; committed before planned selected integer-count capture and all new arithmetic. Not preregistration, a holdout, or independent clinical validation.
objective: Preserve source-positive remission snapshots and diagnosed-T2D history across nominal12/24month visits; derive feasible paired protocol-label tables from verified marginals and a lower-bound same-person positive subgroup. Do not assign missing primary failures to assessed clinical relapse.

one_year.title_prefix: Primary care-led weight management for remission of type 2 diabetes

two_year.title_prefix: Durability of a primary care-led weight-management intervention

one_year.role: public metadata/publication methods source only; no participant dataset acquired

two_year.allowed_inspection: Methods subsections and source/access metadata only; exact numerical outcome cells excluded
two_year.used_source_exposure: Repository main HTML open automatically included abstract descriptive counts/effects before this fetch. Those are incidental used-source; no cells retained or calculated.

itt_n.target: integer participants per group; intervention ITT denominator

itt_n_one_year_crosscheck.target: integer participants per group in the published ITT analysis; must match two-year N

positive_first_n.target: integer intervention-group remission participants, not control count, percentage, odds ratio or rounded percentage-derived N

positive_second_n.anchor: without imputing missing data and assuming no remission for those without data
positive_second_n.target: literal intervention remission numerator and ITT denominator following diabetes was in remission in; commencing-intervention denominator excluded

positive_pair_lower_n.target: first n field belonging to intervention maintaining12/24month remission subgroup; only a lower bound on full positive-positive cell; post-hoc weight analysis not an exhaustive joint cohort table

source_definition_locators.cohort_and_continuation: Two-year physicalp8 design/participants and p11 Results; one-year physicalp4 Findings. Same trial reports, not independent cohorts.
source_definition_locators.positive_remission: Two-year physicalpp9-10 Outcomes and p27 Figure2 legend; source-defined HbA1c/drug-withdrawal endpoint, including GP substitution. No new raw-lab classification.
source_definition_locators.failure_and_unknown: Two-year physicalp10 Statistics and p12 Results; unavailable primary assessments counted as not meeting outcome. Retain unresolved assessment/medication/death partitions.
source_definition_locators.pair_subgroup: Two-year physicalp13 post-hoc weight analysis; maintaining subgroup grammar supports paired positives, but full paired-weight availability/scope is not explicit. Retain marginal-only set as sensitivity.
source_definition_locators.assessment_windows: Two-year physicalpp9-10; nominal visits plus GP-record substitutions are not common exact elapsed times.
source_definition_locators.access: Two-year physicalp22 Data sharing; participant package requires personal application/agreement and has not been acquired.
source_definition_locators.rights: Primary Glasgow repository record180894 identifies accepted manuscript CC BY-NC-ND. Both full PDFs remain fetch-only; limited attributed aggregate facts and Demeter code only. No publisher text, figures, or participant records redistributed.

feasible_set.variables: N=common intervention ITT count; a=first positive marginal; b=second positive marginal; x=unknown positive-positive count; m=reported maintaining-positive subgroup lower bound.
feasible_set.conditional_subgroup_constraint: x >= m, conditional on subgroup belonging to same ITT cohort and its stated paired-positive source meaning; never assert m=x or that all other pair cells were reported.
feasible_set.failure_partition: For first-visit source-positive participants, second primary failure is compatible with assessed nonremission, unassessed/unknown criterion, or death. No observed-negative, unavailable or death count is supplied by these selected cells.
feasible_set.conditional_negative_bounds: Each unreported failure component has nonnegative lower bound and upper bound a-L, where L is lower feasible x. These are mathematical bounds, not observed zero counts, and cannot be chosen independently: source-positive_second + assessed_nonremission + unassessed + death = a.
feasible_set.clinical_membership: Bounds describe recorded source labels and compatible assessment histories. They do not identify latent physiological states, sustained untreated remission, biological relapse, or transitions among never-diabetic healthy/IR/T2D.
feasible_set.uncertainty: Deterministic finite-source feasible-set bounds only, not confidence/credible intervals or joint random draws. Sampling, clustering, assay error, missingness, treatment, exact timing and transport unresolved. No iid assumption, MAR imputation, pooling, annualization, optimizer or hazard fit.
feasible_set.zero_denominator: Conditional shares unavailable when a=0; keep counts and joint table accounting.

failure_policy: Missing/drifted source bytes, wrong version, ambiguous count anchor, inconsistent same-cohort denominator or infeasible counts block derived output.
Do not infer a first-positive N by multiplying a rounded percentage.
Do not use relapsed n, attendance totals or medication/weight patterns to manufacture assessed-negative/death joint cells.
Keep the marginal-only set and explicit subgroup-scope assumption beside any conditional constrained set.
validation_plan: Independently enumerate tiny integer joint tables and compare all bounds/extreme tables.
Conservation, integer/bool/nonfinite/invalid domains, zero first denominator, impossible subgroup, overlapping marginal and subgroup constraints.
Additional information narrows feasible sets; bounds are coupled and not sampling intervals.
Source extraction crosscheck with exact selected PDF crops and independent reviewer; unchanged raw bytes.
Frozen contract/source/registry/provenance guard failures produce sanitized aggregate failure receipt and no derived output.
Full pytest/Ruff/package audit; canonical numerical scenario outputs unchanged; scientific-required remains false.
